counterexample_attempts: Reimplemented polynomial arithmetic over GF(2). The four displayed Frobenius residues, the three Rabin gcds, and X^(2^30) ≡ X all recompute correctly.
Tested whether a nonzero allowed P could be an Artin–Schreier coboundary or give a constant trace word. Its odd-order pole at infinity precludes this, and the character bound is strictly below q.
Checked the endpoint degrees: d=1 gives genus 0 and S(P)=0; d=65 gives genus 32 and the worst certified correlation 2^21.
Checked both b values and the exceptional cases P=0,b=0 and P=0,b=1. They give respectively the zero and all-one words.
Tried the worst sign of S(P) in the weight identity. Both signs still give weight at least (2^30−2^21)/2=535822336.
Recomputed the ancillary degree-67 layer: its generic guarantee is 535789568, exactly 32768 short, while its parameter dimension would be 1021.
Independently counted the narrow-sense BCH designed-distance complement as 1+30+195+10=236 and checked the repeated-root cyclic obstruction.

line_audit.claim: The headline construction has block length 2^30, claimed dimension 991, and beats the dimension-31 baseline.
line_audit.justification: The quotient field and evaluation set are explicitly fixed. The later irreducibility, injectivity, and distance arguments validate these headline parameters; 991>31.

line_audit.claim: The reusable odd-trace lemma gives dimension m(D+1)/2+1 and distance q/2−(D−1)sqrt(q)/2 under (D−1)sqrt(q)<q.
line_audit.justification: Every nonzero reduced polynomial has odd degree at most D, so Hasse–Weil gives correlation at most (D−1)sqrt(q). The strict inequality rules out a kernel, proving the stated dimension.

line_audit.claim: Exact-length cyclic codes have k≤3, and the stated primitive BCH designed-distance route has dimension at most 236.
line_audit.justification: For N=2^30, X^N−1=(X+1)^N. If k≥4, the code contains (X+1)^(N−4), of weight 2^wt2(N−4)=2^28. For the BCH claim, counting binary cyclotomic rotations outside the required defining set gives 1+30+195+10=236.

line_audit.claim: Adding the exponent-67 layer gives dimension 1021 but the generic genus-33 estimate misses the target by 2^15; a fixed coefficient could add one bit under the proposed stronger bound.
line_audit.justification: The 67 cyclotomic coset has size 30 and is disjoint from the earlier exponents. Moreover, 66·2^15=2162688 gives weight 2^29−33·2^15=535789568, whose shortfall is 32768. A binary switch on one fixed coefficient would raise 991 to 992.

line_audit.claim: Every nonzero coefficient polynomial has an odd degree d≤65 and defines a nontrivial Artin–Schreier cover.
line_audit.justification: Distinct permitted monomials have odd exponents. A function h^2+h has even pole order at each pole, so it cannot represent a polynomial having one odd-order pole at infinity.

line_audit.claim: The smooth Artin–Schreier model has genus (d−1)/2≤32 and one rational point above infinity.
line_audit.justification: Infinity is totally ramified in the separable degree-two cover. Riemann–Hurwitz with different exponent d+1 gives genus (d−1)/2, and total ramification over the rational infinity place leaves residue degree one.

line_audit.claim: Hasse–Weil gives |S(P)|≤(d−1)sqrt(q)≤2^21.
line_audit.justification: For the smooth geometrically connected curve, the affine fibers contribute q+S(P) points and the unique infinity point gives q+1+S(P). Thus |S(P)|≤2g sqrt(q)≤64·2^15=2097152.

line_audit.claim: For either constant b, the weight is at least 535822336.
The P=0 cases complete the nonzero-word audit.
line_audit.justification: The b=0 word is zero and the b=1 word is all-one of weight 2^30. Together with P≠0, these cases exhaust the parameter space.

line_audit.claim: The construction is deterministic and symbolically recoverable.
line_audit.justification: The irreducible modulus, polynomial basis, coordinate ordering, 33 exponents, coefficient fields, and binary constant are all fixed. The final code uses no sampling, padding, shortening, or puncturing.

line_audit.claim: The object is a leaderboard submission.
line_audit.justification: It meets the immutable length and distance and has certified dimension 991, strictly exceeding 31.

line_audit.claim: Voloch supports the odd trace representation and Carlitz–Uchiyama bound for the stated BCH parameters.
line_audit.justification: For m=30, t=33, δ=67 and 2t−1=65<2^15+1. The paper records odd trace-polynomial representatives of degree at most 2t−1, the deviation bound (t−1)2^(m/2), and dimension mt in this range. See [Voloch (2001)](https://web.ma.utexas.edu/users/voloch/Preprints/bch.pdf). The submitted finite proof is also independent of this citation.

line_audit.claim: The certified minimum-distance field is 535822336.
line_audit.justification: This is exactly 2^29−2^20=(1/2−2^−10)2^30 and follows from the audited character-sum bound.

line_audit.claim: The listed next tasks correctly distinguish verification, publication, and the unresolved degree-67 question.
line_audit.justification: These are workflow statements and make no additional mathematical assumption in the submitted theorem.

line_audit.claim: The generic degree-67 bound is 535789568, short by 32768, and Serre's refinement gives no gain.
line_audit.justification: The arithmetic recomputes exactly. Since q=2^30 is a square, floor(2sqrt(q))=2sqrt(q), so the Serre form equals the ordinary Hasse–Weil bound.

line_audit.claim: The one-pole Hasse–Weil proof route caps the present reduced polynomial space at k=991.
line_audit.justification: The target forces g≤32, hence reduced odd pole order at most 65. Modulo h^2+h, the positive-degree directions are the 33 odd monomials, each with a 30-bit coefficient, plus one constant bit.

line_audit.claim: Any target-meeting cyclic code of exact length 2^30 has dimension at most 3.
line_audit.justification: The repeated-root argument and the explicit weight-2^28 word for every k≥4 are correct.

line_audit.claim: The parity-extended primitive narrow-sense BCH designed-distance route has maximum dimension 236.
line_audit.justification: The required odd designed distance is 535822335. An exact cyclotomic-rotation count leaves 236 exponent positions outside the defining set; larger designed distance cannot increase dimension.

line_audit.claim: All parameter-ledger values are correct.
X^30+X+1 is irreducible over GF(2).
line_audit.justification: Independent GF(2) arithmetic reproduced the residues at exponents 2^6, 2^10, 2^15 and 2^30. The first three residues plus X have gcd 1 with p, while the final residue is X, satisfying Rabin's criterion for prime divisors 2,3,5 of 30.

line_audit.justification: The field has exactly 2^30 elements, every field element occurs once as a coordinate, and evaluation followed by absolute trace is GF(2)-linear in all parameters.

line_audit.claim: The parameter map is injective and the dimension is 991.
line_audit.justification: A nonzero P producing a constant trace word would force |S(P)|=q, contradicting |S(P)|≤2^21<q. Distinct monomial degrees make P=0 equivalent to all a_i=0, and b supplies one independent bit.

line_audit.claim: Every nonzero codeword satisfies the claimed distance.
line_audit.justification: The exact weight identity handles both signs and both b values for P≠0; P=0,b=1 is all-one. Linearity converts this nonzero-weight bound into minimum distance.

line_audit.claim: Puncturing the x=0 coordinate of the b=0 subcode yields the standard dual-BCH trace code of designed distance 67.
line_audit.justification: Evaluation on F* with odd exponents 1 through 65 is the standard trace representation for δ=2·33+1. Voloch's dimension formula gives 30·33=990, matching the independently proved trace-subcode dimension.
